invariants.name: Tenant Isolation Survives the Entire Path
invariants.description: A transaction or investigation belonging to Tenant A must never affect Tenant B across feature state, model context, graph topology, alerts, cases, cache, database persistence, or webhook identity.

invariants.name: One Financial Event Retains One Logical Identity
invariants.description: Retrying or redelivering the same canonical transaction must not create a second persisted transaction, a second graph edge, a second feature contribution, or duplicate logical case.
invariants.verification_scenario: Scenario 2 — Same Event Redelivery & Scenario 4 — Crash-Window Redelivery

invariants.name: Distinct Events Remain Distinct
invariants.description: Idempotency must not over-deduplicate. Two legitimate transactions between the same accounts must remain distinct when their canonical transaction identities differ, preserving MultiDiGraph parallel edges.

invariants.name: Decision Provenance Remains Bound
invariants.description: A fraud decision must remain strictly and immutably traceable to the exact relevant transaction, tenant, model version, risk score, explanation attributions, and policy state without asynchronous cross-contamination.
invariants.verification_scenario: Scenario 6 — Decision Provenance Under Async Activity

invariants.name: Failure Does Not Become Success
invariants.description: A failure in an authoritative stage (model inference, database persistence, stale case mutation, webhook delivery) must never be converted downstream into a plausible successful business outcome or masked with silent static fallbacks.
enforcement_layers: app.application.services.case_service (HTTP 409 precondition failure on stale CAS)

invariants.name: Retry Does Not Change Meaning
invariants.description: A retry of the same logical operation may repeat transport work but must not change the business meaning merely because it was retried.
invariants.verification_scenario: Scenario 2 — Same Event Redelivery & Scenario 4 — Crash-Window Redelivery

invariants.name: Concurrency Does Not Silently Lose Authoritative State
invariants.description: Concurrent mutations to investigation cases, approvals, or states must either serialize safely via compare-and-set or reject stale updates with conflict errors. Silent lost updates are prohibited.

invariants.name: Security/Privacy Configuration Is Not Merely Decorative
invariants.description: If a runtime path claims Differential Privacy, Secure Aggregation, or Byzantine robust defenses are active, the real execution path must execute those algorithms. Incompatible pipeline configurations must be rejected upfront.
invariants.verification_scenario: Scenario 7 — Active Privacy / Robustness Path Truth

invariants.name: Historical Decisions Do Not Gain Future Evidence
invariants.description: Where point-in-time as_of temporal cutoff semantics exist, later graph edges or events must not leak into historical decision evaluations.

invariants.name: Human Decisions Do Not Rewrite Machine History
invariants.description: Case disposition, false-positive clearance, or supervisor signoff must record human outcomes separately and must never rewrite or mutate historical model scores, versions, or explanations into a different machine result.
enforcement_layers: app.presentation.routers.cases.file_sar_report (disqualifies false positives without altering prediction history)
invariants.verification_scenario: Scenario 10 — Machine Result vs Human Outcome
